# Lumni

> Lumni is the coordination layer for AI agents. Before an agent takes a consequential action (a refund, an email, a CRM write, a deploy), it asks Lumni; Lumni checks the action against what is true now and what other agents and people are doing, and answers ALLOW, DEDUPLICATE, WAIT, REPLAN, REQUIRE_APPROVAL or REJECT. Afterwards Lumni verifies the result in the target app instead of trusting the tool call. No LLM decides; the hard path is deterministic.

Key facts:

- Cloud: https://app.lumniverse.com (14-day trial, then $49/month with 50,000 checks, $3 per extra 1,000). Self-host with Docker Compose. Server and console are FSL-1.1 (Apache-2.0 after two years); SDKs, CLI, skills and examples are Apache-2.0.
- See it work: `npx lumniverse try` runs sample agents that make real mistakes in your workspace while Lumni catches them (it creates an account if needed). Connect a real agent: `npx lumniverse init` in its folder (writes `LUMNI_URL` and `LUMNI_API_KEY`).
- SDKs: TypeScript `@lumniverse/sdk` (Node 22+), Python `lumni-sdk` (3.10+), Go `github.com/lumnihq/lumni/sdk/go`. Adapters for LangGraph, OpenAI Agents, Temporal, Restate, and an MCP gateway.
- Core call: `checkAction({ actor_id, work_id, operation, effect_key, resources, arguments, metadata })`, then act only if `shouldExecute(decision)`, then `startAction` and `reportResult`.
- `effect_key` names the real-world effect (e.g. `refund:<order id>`): the same key means the same effect, which happens once.
- New workspaces run in shadow mode: decisions come back as `WOULD_*` and nothing is blocked until enforcement is turned on.

## Docs

- [Lumni skill for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/skills/lumni/SKILL.md): how to add Lumni to an agent, field by field, and how to handle each decision
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/README.md): what Lumni is, getting started, licensing
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/docs/getting-started.md): one complete workflow, end to end
- [SDKs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/docs/sdk.md): Go, TypeScript and Python clients and durable runtimes
- [TypeScript SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/sdk/typescript/README.md) and [Python SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/sdk/python/README.md)
- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/docs/api.md): authentication, admission and decisions; the full contract is [api/openapi.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/api/openapi.yaml)
- [Integrations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/docs/integrations.md): MCP gateway, OpenTelemetry, GitHub, webhooks

## Running Lumni

- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lumnihq/lumni/main/docs/self-hosting.md): Docker Compose, HTTPS, updates
